highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3 previews runtime stability fixes, updated native dependencies, and hardened native packages.
highlights_body: It addresses an AOT startup crash and Linux ARM64 runtime loading while refreshing the bundled rendering dependencies.

bullets.lead: AOT and Linux ARM64 startup fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes an AOT crash when reflection is disabled and includes fontconfig in the Linux ARM64 cross-compile sysroot.
Updates libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and related native dependency metadata.
Windows and Linux native libraries are built with the Spectre mitigation options.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Added Windows and Linux native Spectre mitigation flags

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Preview 1 delivers AOT and Linux ARM64 fixes, dependency updates, and native binary hardening.

v3.119.3-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3 Preview 1 improves runtime reliability and native package hardening.
v3.119.3-preview.1.1.body: It fixes an AOT startup issue, improves Linux ARM64 runtime support, and refreshes bundled native dependencies.
